title: "Wheels"
author: "Foo Fighters"
date: "2026-02-01"
categories: Foo Fighters
---

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/52vvt1f3sYw >}}

A song full of meaning and purpose that just brings on a new bout of hope and optimism while reaching deep in your soul. The power that which the music is delivered in combination with the lyrics gives you chills. And it all sort of culiminates at the end when you get the drum fill leading into the last chorus that has overlayed guitar parts with the vocals on top. It's like they did all these parts separately through the song, then do it all at once/together at the end for final bang, and then it's over (see [3:57](https://youtu.be/52vvt1f3sYw?list=RD52vvt1f3sYw&t=237)). It is in my top five (5) favorite songs of all time.
